_comment: Products shown on the Store tab. Each one needs a slug: that is the folder name under media/store/ where its pictures live. Drop pictures into media/store/<slug>/ and run watch-models.bat - the watcher fills in the images list below. Everything else here you edit by hand and the watcher leaves alone.

items.title: Full Bermuda Map
items.desc: The complete Free Fire Bermuda map as one Blender scene - all key locations, terrain and landmarks, fully textured and render-ready. .blend file, Blender 3.0+.

items.title: Old Peak 2020 - Free Fire Map
items.desc: The original 2020 Old Peak rebuilt in Blender - classic layout, buildings and terrain, fully textured. .blend file, Blender 3.0+.

items.title: Alpine Map - Snow & Mountain
items.desc: A winter combat environment - snowy peaks, pine forest, frozen terrain and tactical outposts, pre-textured. .blend file, Blender 3.0+.

items.title: World Cup 2026 Football Factory
items.desc: The Free Fire Factory rebuilt as a World Cup arena - field markings, goalposts and themed decoration, fully textured. .blend file, Blender 3.0+.

items.title: Social Island
items.desc: A fully textured recreation of the Free Fire Social Island - themed zones, hangouts and mini-game areas, render-ready. .blend file, Blender 3.0+.

items.title: Lone Wolf Map Pack
items.desc: Multiple 1v1 arena environments including the Iron Cage - full textures and clean shader setups. .blend files, Blender 3.0+.
